name: PopupMenu.library
runtimeDependencies: 68020 or later for the shipped 68020 library
notes: The installed 68020 build (27 January 2001) and English readme match the standalone Aminet pmlib020 archive.
The library also matches Eagleplayer_2.06/Libs/68020/popupmenu.library in the pinned EaglePlayer archive. The shared library is catalogued here.

Directory Opus, SimpleFind and SimpleFindPrefs, BWin.mcc, and EaglePlayer’s EagleAMPGui engines reference the library. The installed package adds no L: handler or separate PopupMenu preferences program.
